messages.subject: automated saving of output image from fieldcount function
parts:
Hi
I am trying to get the field count loop to work with an automated image save of the output image. This i would like to have for veryfication and quality check of the methode.
 code I use:
dev.copy(jpeg,'C:/Users/mg/document/myplot.jpeg')
dev.off()

My problem is that the image dose not look like it should.
It look like it resize the reed dots for the count so it do not overlay with the plants counted.

Do anyone know how to solve this, or if there is a better method for autosave output images
Regards
Martin

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: automated saving of output image from fieldcount function
parts:
Hi Martin,

You can´t change the plotting area after pressing RUN in the function. If the image is being evaluated and you, for example, increase the plotting area the output plot will be out of reference. Try running again and not changing the plotting area and let us know... Hope it makes sense.

All the best,
Filipe

I have solved it in another way which seems to work

mypath <- file.path("C:/Users/mg/Agrolab A S/R&D - Dokumenter/1 Running projects/Education/Emergence count/Output",paste("myplot_", pics[i], sep = ""))

Martin
